editcheck-dialog-addref-description: Help readers make dem barb wer dis information dey cam from by adding a citation.
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-question: Why you no dey add citation?
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-descripti: Oda editors go value make dem learn more about your decision why you no add a citation.
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-irrelevan: I no dey think say citations be relevant to de change wey adey make
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-common-kn: De information wey adey add be widely known
editcheck-dialog-addref-reject-uncertain: Ano sure wey citation ago add
editcheck-copyvio-description: Abeg make you no copy text from oda sources, even say dem rephrase anaa dem cite am. Dem fi consider dis [{{int:editcheck-copyvio-descriptionlink}} copyright violation anaa plagiarism] wey fi make dem komot your content anaa dem fi block your account.
editcheck-copyvio-keep-description: Abeg help oda editors of dis article make dem barb why you keep de pasted text.
editcheck-copyvio-keep-wrote: Me per dey write dis content wey eno dey any wer else
editcheck-copyvio-keep-other: All de above no dey ply
editcheck-copyvio-keep-notify: Thanks say you share your reason to keep de pasted text!
editcheck-copyvio-remove-notify: Thanks say you help keep knowledge freely available!
editcheck-double-bold-title: Comot bold formatting wey no necessary
editcheck-double-bold-description: Dem dey apply bold automatically to subheadings, definition list terms den table headers. Make you help readers komot [{{int:editcheck-double-bold-descriptionlink}} bold formatting wey no dey hia] from dese elements.
editcheck-tone-description: Oda users often dey revise dis kind of wording, wey dey talk say de tone no balance. [{{int:editcheck-tone-descriptionlink}} Learn more]
editcheck-tone-footer: You fi identify using a [{{int:editcheck-tone-footerlink}} BERT model]
editcheck-tone-description-acted: Look out for expressions wey be flattering, disparaging, vague, cliché, anaa endorsing of a particular viewpoint.
editcheck-tone-reject-uncertain: Ano sure how afi revise de tone
editcheck-yearlink-description: Dis link dey point to a different year dan de one dem show insyd de text. Make you help make de article more accurate by updating de displayed year den linked year to match.
editcheck-external-link-description: Dis link dey point to an [{{int:editcheck-external-link-descriptionlink}} external website]. Help readers make dem stay focus for de content top by removing dis link, move am to de “External links” section, anaa convert am into a [{{int:editcheck-external-link-convertlink}} citation] if appropriate.
editcheck-duplicate-link-description: Dis link dey appear more dan one insyd dis section. Make you help readers navigate more easily by removing [{{int:editcheck-duplicate-link-descriptionlink}} repeated links].
editcheck-disambiguation-title: Link am to page wey bi more specific
editcheck-disambiguation-description: Dis link dey point to a [{{int:editcheck-disambiguation-descriptionlink}} disambiguation page]. Make you help readers find de right topic by linking to a more specific page.
editcheck-headinglevel-description: Samtyms dis heading level no go follow de correct sequential structure. Make you help readers navigate de content more easily by using de correct [{{int:editcheck-headinglevel-descriptionlink}} heading level].
editcheck-image-caption-description: Dis image no get caption. Help readers make dem barb why de image be relevant by adding a [{{int:editcheck-image-caption-descriptionlink}} short caption].
editcheck-convertreference-description: Dis reference dey miss details. Help readers make dem barb wer de information dey cam from by converting dis into a formatted [{{int:editcheck-convertreference-descriptionlink}} reference]. After you convert am, check de accuracy of de details wey de tool add, den komot anything wey be wrong anaa confusing.
editcheck-reject-description: Oda editors go dey appreciate why you dey make this choice.
editcheck-specialeditchecks-info: Dem configure Edit checks at [[MediaWiki:Editcheck-config.json]]. For documentation, spy [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Edit_check/Configuration Edit check/Configuration].
editcheck-specialeditchecks-disabled: Dem no dey enable edit checks  for this wiki.
tag-editcheck-reference-decline-common-k: Dem decline EditCheck reference as common knowledge
tag-editcheck-reference-decline-irreleva: Dem decline EditCheck reference as irrelevant
tag-editcheck-reference-decline-other-de: Dem decline editCheck reference for reason wey dem no list
tag-editcheck-reference-decline-uncertai: Dem dey decline editCheck reference sekof eno certain
